final_message:
I rewrote the description in `skills/parquet-schema-check/SKILL.md`, but I haven't tested it, so I don't yet know whether agents will load the skill.

**Cause.** The description was `Helps with parquet files.` Agents only see the description before the skill loads, and that one gave them no trigger to match.

**Change.** The new description is:

> Use when about to write, save, export or overwrite a parquet file (to_parquet, pq.write_table, df.write.parquet), or when a downstream job reads a parquet file and fails on missing columns, wrong column order or dtype mismatch

It names the moment of writing, the common write calls and the downstream failures. I left out the steps (compare to the schema, don't cast) on purpose. The writing-skills guidance says a description that summarizes the workflow lets agents follow the summary and skip the skill body.

**Not done**
- **No test.** The skill's own rules say a change like this needs a before/after trigger test. That means at least three should-load prompts and three near-miss prompts, each run in a fresh session with the old and the new description. I can't start fresh sessions with the tools I have here. The baseline from earlier isn't in the repo either (`specs/baseline/` doesn't exist), so I have no written prompts to reuse. Treat this as an untested fix. I can draft the prompt set if you want to run it.
- **Missing `license`.** The frontmatter has no `license` field, which the skill's checklist requires. No other skill in this repo sets one either, so I didn't guess a value. Tell me which license to use and I'll add it.
- **Possible second cause.** If agents still don't load it, the skill listing may be dropping descriptions when it overflows. I haven't checked that.
